belongs_to: Figure it Out Q11: 'A colony of ants set out in search of food. As they search, they keep splitting equally at each point (as shown in the Fig. 8.7) and reach two food sources, one near a mango tree and another near a sugarcane field. What fraction of the original group reached each food source?'
description: A branching network of thick teal-green paths with white arrows showing the direction of travel (upward / up-right), 4 red filled circles (split points, numbered here 1 to 4 from the bottom) and two dark-red label bars at the top with white text: 'Mango tree' (a wide bar at the top-left) and 'Sugarcane field' (a bar at the top-right, to the right of the Mango bar). Start: a short vertical path at the bottom with an up arrow leads into red circle 1. From circle 1: (a) one path goes up-left then bends and runs straight up to the Mango tree bar (1 white arrow on it); (b) one path goes up-right (arrow) to circle 2. From circle 2: (a) one path goes up-left, bends, runs straight up to the Mango tree bar (arrow); (b) one path goes up-right (arrow) to circle 3. From circle 3 FOUR paths leave: two go up-left to the Mango tree bar (the first bends and ends further left, the second goes straighter; each has one arrow, so two separate endings at the Mango bar), one goes straight up (arrow) to circle 4, and one long path goes up-right (arrow) to the Sugarcane field bar. From circle 4 TWO paths leave: one goes straight up to the Mango tree bar (arrow) and one goes up-right (arrow) to the Sugarcane field bar (a shorter path, ending left of the long one). Totals: 5 paths end at the Mango tree bar, 2 paths end at the Sugarcane field bar, 11 white arrows in all, 4 red circles. Fractions are NOT written anywhere on the figure. The caption 'Fig. 8.7' is printed below (not part of the drawing).
unclear: From circle 3 four outgoing paths were read (2 to Mango, 1 to circle 4, 1 to Sugarcane); this is the picture's reading and decides the fractions in the answer.
Exact horizontal positions of the endings along the Mango bar are not important.
